mentions.name: Camic
mentions.description: Camic is a mental health app that helps people manage their mental health issues. It grew out of the builder's own long-term struggles with mental health and with starting projects they never finish, and it is now close to completion.
mentions.problem: Mental health struggles; the builder has dealt with mental health issues for 20 years and wanted a project that helps with them.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://www.camic.app/

I’ve been doing two things for 20 years. One is starting projects I never finish and one is struggling with mental health.

Now it actually seems like I’m gonna finish a project that helps me with my health issues. Double bingo!
mentions.author: j-sanden
